column1: # Publishes the per-orthogroup all-annotations table (+ validation report).
# Source globs are relative to this manifest's directory (workflow-RUN_* root).
# Build with (from the integrator subproject root):
# This is a COPYME template (single source of truth). The discovery helper
# ignores manifests in workflow-COPYME-* dirs; copy this file into the canonical
# workflow-RUN_* dir for it to publish (per gigantic_conventions §38/§39).
# ----- Headline deliverable: the per-orthogroup all-annotations table -----

column6: One row per OrthoHMM orthogroup. Fixed columns (Orthogroup_ID, comma-delimited member sequence IDs, member count, singleton flag) then TWO columns for each of ten annotation types (Pfam, GO, PANTHER, Annogroups_Pfam, Annogroups_GO, Annogroups_PANTHER, Gene_Families, Gene_Groups, Dark_Proteome, Hotspots): comma-delimited non-redundant identifiers and ' // '-delimited names aligned to the identifiers (Hotspots names are intentionally blank). Filename includes a run timestamp suffix _monthdd_hhmm. Followed by a species-tree deconvolution — one column per non-redundant clade/species across structures 001, 003, 031, 032 giving the count of member sequences within that clade.

Fail-fast validation cross-checks (row count vs input orthogroups, member-count vs sequence-ID count, singleton flag, deconvolution completeness where the species columns sum to the member count and root clades equal it, per-type count ranges and coverage consistency, and identifier/name alignment). Status PASS means every cross-check held.
